'''Amadaine 13 (June 20)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|998}} - As the ''[[River Queen]]'' approaches [[Tar Valon]], the [[Amyrlin Seat|Amyrlin]] visits [[Egwene]] and [[Nynaeve]]. After arriving at Tar Valon, they meet [[Sheriam Bayanar]], who takes them into the [[White Tower|Tower]].
*{{ne|999}} - [[Perrin]] visits his family's graves with [[Faile]]. He and his men are ambushed by [[Trolloc]]s and Perrin is wounded. They stay the night in a [[Tinker]] encampment. Perrin learns the Faile is the daughter of [[Davram Bashere]]. In the [[Tel'aran'rhiod|wolf dream]], he finds the [[Waygate]] unlocked and is almost ambushed by [[Slayer]].
